subject: maths
question: Sharman is 20 percent less efficient than Vivek. If Vivek can make a helmet in 20 days, then in how many days can Sharman make the same helmet?
solution:
**Given:**

Sharman is 20 percent less efficient than Vivek.

Vivek can make a helmet in 20 days.

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency Ratio = Work done by Sharman / Work done by Vivek

Time = Work / Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of Vivek be 1 unit/day.

Efficiency of Sharman = 0.8 unit/day (20% less than Vivek)

Time taken by Vivek to make 1 helmet = 20 days

Work done by Vivek in making 1 helmet = 20 days × 1 unit/day = 20 units

Time taken by Sharman to make the same helmet:

⇒ Time = Work / Efficiency

⇒ Time = 20 units / 0.8 units/day

⇒ Time = 25 days

**Sharman can make the same helmet in 25 days.**
